name: SDF Voxel Grid Generation (Brute Force)
definition: A method where each cell in a 3D voxel grid holds the minimum distance to the surface of an object, computed by iterating through all triangles in the mesh.
summary: SDF Voxel Grid Generation (Brute Force) computes exact signed distances by checking every voxel against all mesh triangles, ensuring high accuracy at the cost of quadratic computational complexity.
